Per contra, Smt.Preethi Shashank, learned counsel for the respondent No.2/Insurance Company supports the impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal and submits that the appellants have not placed any evidence with regard to the income and hence, the assessment of the income by the Tribunal is just and proper and does not call for any modification.
She further submits that the assessment of disability in all the appeals by the Tribunal is on the higher side.
Hence, no need to enhance any compensation in these appeals.
She submits that the Tribunal erred in awarding compensation under the head of loss of future prospectus of the appellants/claimants, which they are not entitled.
Hence, she seeks to dismiss all the appeals.
